title: Malicious code in express-helmet (npm)
description: The npm package 'express-helmet' has been identified as containing malicious code. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, potentially allowing an attacker full control over the affected computer. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the compromised system is advised. Removal of the package is recommended, but it may not fully eliminate the malicious presence due to potential persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
